property_summary: In the reference contract, two fallback calls within the same timestamp can never both succeed (the second reverts because the timestamp must exceed pastBlockTime), while the mutant removes this check so the second call succeeds — asserting the second same-timestamp call fails passes on P and fails on M.
change_summary: Remove the requirement that the timestamp must exceed pastBlockTime, allowing multiple calls in the same block.
